# NovaBESS
> Your ready-to-use energy storage partner. NovaBESS supplies plug-and-play residential and industrial battery energy storage systems (BESS), backed by a 40-year manufacturer with CE, UN38.3, UL and IEC certifications.

## About / Factory
- [About NovaBESS](https://novabess.com/about.html): Export brand backed by a 40-year battery manufacturer. 7 production bases, 600+ acres, 3,000+ employees. ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949. Factory tours and certificates available to qualified buyers.

## Products
- [HomeStack — Stackable ESS](https://novabess.com/products.html#homestack): 5 / 10 / 15 kWh modular residential battery. 51.2 V nominal, 43.2–58.4 V operating range, 100 A max continuous current, CAN/RS485, IP54, -25°C to +50°C. Parallel up to 12 stacks / 60 kWh. UN38.3 certified.
- [HomeWall — Wall-Mounted Battery](https://novabess.com/products.html#homewall): 48 V wall-mounted lithium battery in 2.5 / 5.1 / 10.2 kWh (50 / 100 / 200 Ah). 5,000 cycles at 80% DoD, 15-year design life, IP54, LCD display, parallel up to 15 units. CE, UN38.3, UL, IEC certified.
- [PowerBox — Industrial Mobile Power](https://novabess.com/products.html#powerbox):
- [PowerBox for Commercial & Industrial](https://novabess.com/powerbox-cic.html): Wheeled LiFePO4 industrial power (4/8/16 kWh, CE/UN38.3/UL/IEC) for construction, telecom, mining, emergency and off-grid O&M. No install, charges from wall/solar/generator. OEM white-label available. 4.02 / 8.04 / 16.08 kWh wheeled portable power station. 12.8 / 25.6 / 51.2 V, 500 / 1000 / 1500 W, 314 Ah LFP cells, 80%–100% DoD, air-cooled, ≤75 dB(A). CE, UN38.3, UL, IEC certified.
- [C&I and Container BESS](https://novabess.com/products.html#commercial): Air-cooled cabinet (672–864 VDC, 400 VAC), liquid-cooled cabinet (200–1000 kWh per cabinet, 728–949 VDC, ≥95% round-trip efficiency, LFP 314 Ah), and ISO 40 ft container systems for grid, commercial & industrial, renewable and microgrid projects.

## Why NovaBESS
- Plug-and-play: no local installer required for residential and mobile units — receive it, connect it, use it.
- 40-year manufacturer: 7 production bases, 3,000+ employees, full in-house cell-to-system chain and certifications.
- Global certifications: CE, UN38.3, UL, IEC, ISO 9001, ISO 14001, IATF 16949. Ready for EU, AU, Middle East and Africa.
- Cloud monitoring: app-based remote diagnostics and 7×24 status.

## Tools
- [Home Battery Calculator](https://novabess.com/calculator.html): Free interactive tool to size your home battery (kWh), pick a model and estimate payback in 30 seconds. No email required to use.
- [Solar Battery Cost per kWh Calculator](https://novabess.com/solar-battery-cost-calculator.html): Enter capacity (kWh) and quoted price to see your cost per usable kWh against 2026 LiFePO4 market ranges ($400-900 equipment, $800-1,500 installed) and lifetime $/kWh-cycle vs lead-acid (~$0.12 vs ~$0.50). No email required.
- [Solar Battery Size Calculator](https://novabess.com/solar-battery-calculator.html): Enter PV array size (kW), peak sun hours and daily use — see the right battery capacity in kWh, self-sufficiency %, and a recommended LiFePO4 model (HomeWall / HomeStack). No email required.
- [Solar Payback Calculator](https://novabess.com/solar-payback-calculator.html): Enter system cost, incentive %, monthly bill and annual escalation — see payback period (years) and 10/25-year lifetime net savings vs staying on the grid. No email required.
- [Tesla Powerwall Alternative](https://novabess.com/tesla-powerwall-alternative.html): Side-by-side comparison of the Tesla Powerwall 3 vs NovaBESS HomeWall and HomeStack on capacity, chemistry (LFP vs NMC), cycle life, warranty/design life, power, scalability, certifications and price per kWh. Independent buyer's view for those shopping a Powerwall alternative.
- [Residential Battery Storage Buying Guide](https://novabess.com/residential-battery-storage.html): 2026 guide to home battery storage — how to size by usable kWh, compare LiFePO4 vs NMC vs lead-acid, read the six specs that matter, check inverter compatibility and certifications, and estimate cost per kWh ($400-900 equipment LFP, ~$0.12/kWh-cycle lifetime).
- [Solar Battery Backup Guide](https://novabess.com/solar-battery-backup.html): How a rooftop PV + LiFePO4 storage system keeps a home powered through outages — how it works (islanding), sizing by usable kWh, battery vs generator, and NovaBESS HomeWall / HomeStack backup options.
- [Solar Battery Backup Calculator](https://novabess.com/solar-battery-backup-calculator.html): Enter essential load (W), backup hours and outage days — see required usable and nameplate kWh, runtime per charge, solar recharge during multi-day outages, and a recommended HomeWall / HomeStack model. No email required.
- [Home Battery Backup Without Solar](https://novabess.com/home-battery-backup-without-solar.html): Size a grid-charged backup battery (no solar) by essential load and hours — capacity in kWh, cost, and payback from peak/off-peak arbitrage. No email required.

## Services & Cases
- [OEM Energy Storage Supplier & ODM Factory](https://novabess.com/oem-odm.html): Looking for an OEM energy storage supplier or ODM factory? NovaBESS offers white-label (HomeStack, HomeWall, PowerBox) and custom battery manufacturing, backed by a 40-year group, with CE/UN38.3/IEC 62619. 7-step cooperation process for distributors, installers, brand owners and project developers. Also provides O&M (operations and maintenance) and after-sales support for BESS — remote monitoring via cloud BMS, preventive maintenance, and regional spare parts and warranty.
- [Application Case Studies](https://novabess.com/case-studies.html): Representative deployment scenarios — off-grid home backup, solar self-consumption, remote/telecom sites, and space-limited apartments.

## Blog
- [Home Battery Storage Buying Guide 2026](https://novabess.com/blog/home-battery-buying-guide-2026.html): How to size a home battery by daily kWh and match it to backup, solar self-consumption or off-grid goals.
- [Portable Power for Off-Grid & Construction Sites](https://novabess.com/blog/portable-power-offgrid-construction.html): Wheeled battery power vs diesel, specs and use cases for PowerBox.
- [Solar Self-Consumption with HomeWall](https://novabess.com/blog/solar-self-consumption-homewall.html): Pair rooftop PV with a wall-mounted battery to use more of your own solar at night.
- [How Long Do Home Batteries Last?](https://novabess.com/blog/how-long-do-home-batteries-last.html): Cycle life vs calendar life, depth of discharge, warranty, and how to get 10+ years from a home battery.
- [Home Battery Sizing Calculator](https://novabess.com/blog/home-battery-sizing-calculator.html): A 4-step method to size a home battery by daily kWh, overnight load and backup days.
- [What Can a 10 kWh Battery Run?](https://novabess.com/blog/what-can-a-10kwh-battery-run.html): Realistic appliance load list and runtime for a 10 kWh home battery, including why AC changes the math.
- [Home Battery Cost & Payback in 2026](https://novabess.com/blog/home-battery-cost-payback-2026.html): Equipment cost, what drives payback, and whether a battery pays off without solar.
- [Solar Battery Cost per kWh in 2026](https://novabess.com/blog/solar-battery-cost-per-kwh.html): The $/kWh formula (cost ÷ usable kWh), typical LiFePO4 ranges (equipment and installed), what drives price, and how NovaBESS HomeWall (2.5/5.1/10.2 kWh) and HomeStack (5 kWh to 60 kWh) compare on cost per usable kWh.
- [LiFePO4 Battery Disadvantages: 5 Real Drawbacks](https://novabess.com/blog/lifepo4-battery-disadvantages.html): Honest look at cost, energy density, cold-weather charging, cold charge speed and system matching — and when LiFePO4 still wins for home and small-business storage.
- [What Size Solar Battery Do I Need to Be Off Grid?](https://novabess.com/blog/off-grid-battery-sizing.html): The 3 numbers (daily kWh, autonomy days, usable DoD), the sizing formula, a worked 25 kWh example, and how to map the result to real NovaBESS LiFePO4 products. Links the free off-grid calculator.
- [48V 100Ah Server Rack Battery: Compared for 2026](https://novabess.com/blog/48v-100ah-server-rack-battery.html): What a 48V 100Ah rack module is (~5.12 kWh), the 6 specs that separate good from bad, and how NovaBESS HomeStack (51.2V, 5 kWh module, parallel to 60 kWh) fits this class. Buyer's comparison framework.
- [How to Choose an OEM Energy Storage Supplier](https://novabess.com/blog/how-to-choose-oem-energy-storage-supplier.html): A 2026 buyer's guide — manufacturer vs trader, certifications that clear customs (CE/UN38.3/IEC 62619), proven models, lead time and engineering support.
- [What Does an ODM Energy Storage Factory Do?](https://novabess.com/blog/odm-energy-storage-factory.html): OEM vs ODM, what an ODM factory designs (capacity, enclosure, BMS, protocols) and when to choose custom build.
- [48V vs 51.2V Rack Battery](https://novabess.com/blog/48v-vs-51v-rack-battery.html): Same 16-cell LiFePO4 platform under two labels. Nominal vs full-charge voltage, matching a 48V inverter, and the kWh math (51.2V x 100Ah approx 5.12 kWh). Worked example with NovaBESS HomeStack (51.2V nominal, 43.2-58.4V range, 60 kWh parallel).
- [Battery Peak Shaving & Time-of-Use Arbitrage](https://novabess.com/blog/battery-peak-shaving-arbitrage.html): How a home battery charges cheap off-peak and discharges expensive peak to cut bills — the savings formula, real 2026 country savings ($900-1,400/yr Australia, ~£690 UK, €400+ Ireland), and which markets it pays best in (AU/UK/DE/US T1; IE/NL/DK/PL/F R T2; ZA/ES/AE weak). No solar required; inverter must support AC grid charging in TOU mode.
- [Home Battery Peak Shaving in Australia 2026](https://novabess.com/blog/battery-peak-shaving-australia.html): Australia is the world's strongest arbitrage market — Synergy Midday Saver ~8.6c vs 53.8c peak (~45c spread), SA TOU ~31.5c spread, VPP income $130-350/yr. Cheaper Home Batteries federal rebate (~$244-252/kWh to Dec 2026, $7.2B to 2030) + state stacks (WA up to $1,300/$3,800, NSW $1,500, ACT loan). 10 kWh net ~$7,200-11,200, payback 4.5-8 yrs, $900-1,400/yr saving. CEC-approved + VPP-capable required.
- [Home Battery Peak Shaving in the UK 2026](https://novabess.com/blog/battery-peak-shaving-uk.html): UK is Europe's best dynamic-tariff market. Octopus Go ~9.5p off-peak vs ~33p peak (~23p spread) earns ~£773/yr on 10 kWh; Intelligent Go 8p/6h (EV), Agile 5-50p variable, Flux for solar. Smart meter + TOU tariff + grid-charging inverter required. UK 10 kWh install ~£6,000-9,000, payback 5-8 yrs. No solar needed; CE/UKCA-ready systems.
- [Portable Home Battery Backup (No Install)](https://novabess.com/blog/portable-home-battery-backup.html): Wheeled LiFePO4 backup for renters, apartments and blackouts — no electrician, no wiring. PowerBox 4/8/16 kWh (500/1000/1500 W), charges from wall/solar/generator, CE/UN38.3/UL/IEC. Portable vs fixed decision table, sizing and cost.
- [Battery Backup for Apartment Renters](https://novabess.com/blog/battery-backup-for-apartments.html): How renters keep the lights on with a plug-in battery — no landlord approval, no permit. What to run (fridge/router/lights/medical), sizing, safety (no backfeed, CE/UL), PowerBox specs.
- [Power Outage Backup With No Installation](https://novabess.com/blog/power-outage-backup-no-install.html): Blackout prep with a wheeled LiFePO4 unit — silent, fume-free, ready same-day. Battery vs generator, priority loads, runtime by model, medical-device note, PowerBox specs.
- [Portable Power Station vs Generator](https://novabess.com/blog/portable-power-station-vs-generator.html): Plain-English comparison for home backup — fuel, noise, indoor safety, runtime, refuel, output, maintenance, cost, weight, apartment fit. Why a wheeled LiFePO4 station (no fuel, no fumes, indoor-safe) wins for most homes; PowerBox 4/8/16 kWh specs.
- [Plug-In Battery vs Portable Power Station](https://novabess.com/blog/plug-in-battery-no-install.html): What "no-install" backup really means — socket-feed plug-in batteries (whole-circuit, ~800 W) vs device-plug portable power stations (PowerBox). Renter fit, no-electrician benefits, and where the plug-in category is booming (Germany, Netherlands, UK).
- [CIC Powerbox Alternative: What to Consider](https://novabess.com/blog/cic-powerbox-alternative.html): Buyer's framework for commercial & industrial portable power — generic CIC boxes vs NovaBESS PowerBox vs diesel generator vs consumer station on capacity, certs (CE/UN38.3/UL/IEC), noise, cost and safe use.
- [CIC Powerbox Alternative — Australia](https://novabess.com/blog/cic-powerbox-alternative-australia.html): AU buyer's framework — RCM/IECEx, mining, Outback telecom and remote construction; generic CIC box vs NovaBESS PowerBox vs generator vs consumer station.
- [CIC Powerbox Alternative — North America](https://novabess.com/blog/cic-powerbox-alternative-north-america.html): US & Canada buyer's framework — UL 2743, CSA, cold-climate mining and telecom; portable power station certs and duty fit.
- [CIC Powerbox Alternative — Europe](https://novabess.com/blog/cic-powerbox-alternative-europe.html): Germany & UK buyer's framework — CE/UKCA, TA Lärm noise limits, UK red-diesel phase-out; battery vs generator for sites and events.
